cases.evidence: solution NMR paramagnetic relaxation enhancement; strongest PRE maps residues 77-87 in the central linker contacting the nanoparticle during the transient encounter complex
cases.notes: NMR buffer pH 6.5. The paper reports very similar holo and NP-bound conformations and identifies the acidic 77-87 linker by PRE as the transient contact region; N-terminal EF1/EF2 CSPs represent a tighter second-step interaction and are not merged into this PRE ground-truth region. PDB 1CLL chain A is human Ca2+-loaded calmodulin.
